# Rule 1.1 - Be Creative With Your Gimmicks
When playing a character with a specific gimmick — [color=#a41683][bold]Clown[/bold][/color], [color=#776d66][bold]Mime[/bold][/color], or otherwise — you should make a concentrated effort to add both variety and engagement with your respective gimmick.
## Precedents
- This rule mainly applies to crew-aligned individuals. Nobody enjoys your third time stealing shoes or constantly slipping [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color]. You should not rely on the same exact [italic]modus operandi[/italic] every round. - If you are an antagonist, you are encouraged to vary your gameplan for the sake of fun. You can choose to use the same options if you'd like, [textlink="barring mass sabotage." link="RuleAntagonist"] (Nobody will enjoy your third tesloose.)
